hints.title: Small Target Partition
hints.text: Since (x1 ^ x2) + (y1 ^ y2) = k and k is between 0 and 100, we can partition k into a + b = k with 0 <= a <= k.

hints.title: XOR Inversion Property
hints.text: If x1 ^ x2 = a, then x2 = x1 ^ a. Similarly, y2 = y1 ^ b.

hints.title: Hash Map Pairing
hints.text: For each point (x1, y1), iterate a from 0 to k, lookup (x1 ^ a, y1 ^ (k - a)) in the frequency map of previously seen points, then record (x1, y1).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: k + 1 hash map lookups per coordinate.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested loop over all coordinate pairs times out for n = 50,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary hash map to track coordinates seen so far.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use XOR involution and iterate over partitions of small k.
